name: E2E：生图节点-单图输出模式端到端验证
description: 配置生图节点输出模式为'拆分成单图给下游'，保存后试运行，验证输出结果为独立图片URL列表（每张图一个URL）

steps.description: 打开含生图节点的策略详情页
验证生图详情页已加载

steps.expression: return (() => { const allEls = document.querySelectorAll('*'); for (const el of allEls) { const t = (el.textContent || '').trim(); if (t === '生图' && el.children.length === 0) { const rect = el.getBoundingClientRect(); if (rect.width > 0 && rect.height > 0) { el.click(); return { clicked: true }; } } } return { clicked: false }; })()

return (() => { const drawer = document.querySelector('.ant-drawer:not(.ant-drawer-hidden)'); if (!drawer) return { open: false }; const radios = Array.from(drawer.querySelectorAll('.ant-radio-wrapper')); const radioInfo = radios.map(r => ({ label: (r.textContent || '').trim(), checked: !!r.querySelector('input[type=radio]:checked') })); const checked = radioInfo.find(r => r.checked); return { open: true, radios: radioInfo, currentMode: checked ? checked.label : null, isSingleMode: checked ? checked.label.includes('拆分') || checked.label.includes('单图') : false }; })()

return (() => { const drawer = document.querySelector('.ant-drawer:not(.ant-drawer-hidden)'); if (!drawer) return { skipped: true }; const radios = Array.from(drawer.querySelectorAll('.ant-radio-wrapper')); const checked = radios.find(r => !!r.querySelector('input[type=radio]:checked')); if (checked && (checked.textContent || '').includes('拆分')) return { alreadySingle: true, skipped: false }; const singleRadio = radios.find(r => { const t = (r.textContent || '').trim(); return t.includes('拆分') || t.includes('单图'); }); if (singleRadio) { const inp = singleRadio.querySelector('input[type=radio]'); if (inp) { inp.click(); return { switched: true, to: (singleRadio.textContent || '').trim() }; } } return { noSingleRadio: true }; })()
steps.description: 确保输出模式为'拆分成单图给下游'

steps.expression: return (() => { const drawer = document.querySelector('.ant-drawer:not(.ant-drawer-hidden)'); if (!drawer) return {}; const radios = Array.from(drawer.querySelectorAll('.ant-radio-wrapper')); const checked = radios.find(r => !!r.querySelector('input[type=radio]:checked')); const modelSelect = drawer.querySelector('.ant-select'); const modelValue = modelSelect ? (modelSelect.querySelector('.ant-select-selection-item')?.textContent || '').trim() : ''; return { confirmedMode: checked ? (checked.textContent || '').trim() : 'unknown', modelValue, isSingle: checked ? (checked.textContent || '').includes('拆分') : false }; })()
steps.description: 确认输出模式已设为单图模式
输出模式已切换为'拆分成单图给下游'

steps.expression: return (() => { const modal = document.querySelector('.ant-modal:not(.ant-modal-hidden)'); if (!modal) return { open: false }; const inputs = Array.from(modal.querySelectorAll('input:not([type=checkbox]), textarea')); const filledInputs = {}; for (const inp of inputs) { const label = (inp.closest('.ant-form-item')?.querySelector('.ant-form-item-label')?.textContent || '').trim(); if (label.includes('seller')) { const setter = Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(window.HTMLInputElement.prototype, 'value').set; setter.call(inp, 'test_seller_001'); inp.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', { bubbles: true })); inp.dispatchEvent(new Event('change', { bubbles: true })); filledInputs.seller_id = 'test_seller_001'; } } return { open: true, filledInputs }; })()

return (() => { const modal = document.querySelector('.ant-modal:not(.ant-modal-hidden)'); if (!modal) return { ok: false }; const btns = Array.from(modal.querySelectorAll('button')); const runBtn = btns.find(b => { const t = (b.textContent || '').trim(); return t === '运行' || t === '开始运行' || t.includes('运行'); }); if (runBtn && !runBtn.disabled) { runBtn.click(); return { ok: true, buttonText: (runBtn.textContent || '').trim() }; } return { ok: false, disabled: runBtn?.disabled }; })()

steps.description: 等待生图运行完成(可能耗时较长)

steps.expression: return (() => { const modal = document.querySelector('.ant-modal:not(.ant-modal-hidden)'); if (modal) { const closeBtn = modal.querySelector('.ant-modal-close'); if (closeBtn) closeBtn.click(); } return { closed: true }; })()

steps.description: 等待弹窗关闭和状态更新

steps.expression: return (() => { const btns = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('button')); const resultBtn = btns.find(b => { const t = (b.textContent || '').trim(); return t === '查看运行结果'; }); if (resultBtn) { resultBtn.click(); return { clicked: true, text: '查看运行结果' }; } const allBtns = btns.map(b => (b.textContent||'').trim()).filter(Boolean); return { clicked: false, buttonLabels: allBtns.slice(0, 15) }; })()
steps.description: 点击查看运行结果按钮
等待运行结果页面加载

steps.expression: return (() => { const text = document.body.innerText || ''; const urls = text.match(/https?:\/\/[^\s"']+(?:\.jpg|\.png|\.webp|\.jpeg)/gi) || []; const allHttpUrls = text.match(/https?:\/\/[^\s"'<]+/gi) || []; const hasResult = text.includes('运行结果') || text.includes('成功') || text.includes('完成') || text.includes('输出') || text.includes('试运行') || text.includes('策略'); const hasError = text.includes('失败') || text.includes('错误'); const hasLoading = text.includes('运行中') || !!document.querySelector('.ant-spin-spinning'); const hasViewBtn = text.includes('查看运行结果'); return { hasLoading, hasResult, hasError, hasViewBtn, imageUrlCount: urls.length, imageUrls: urls.slice(0, 10), allUrlCount: allHttpUrls.length, allUrls: allHttpUrls.slice(0, 15) }; })()

steps.label: e2e-single-mode-result
steps.description: 单图模式试运行结果截图

_testDesign.preconditions: F88预发已登录；策略10602含生图节点且配置完整(模型类型/Prompt/输入图片)
_testDesign.realDomNotes: 单图模式: 每张图片输出独立的URL; 输出格式为数组/列表，每个元素为一张图片URL
riskPoints: 单图模式输出是否为多张独立图片URL
每张图片URL是否可正常访问
输出结果是否包含图片格式标识(jpg/png/webp)
运行是否超时(生图耗时可能10-30s)
_testDesign.validationRule: imageUrlCount >= 1 且各URL独立(非打包格式)
